name: miele-line
description: ビューティサロン ミエーレ LINE公式アカウント連携（フェーズ1：受け口）

scripts.db:friends: wrangler d1 execute miele --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS friends FROM customers WHERE status='active'"
scripts.db:unmatched: wrangler d1 execute miele --remote --command "SELECT body, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inbound_messages WHERE matched IS NULL GROUP BY body ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30"
